_comment: Every version's release notes, newest first: the one place they are written. dev/notes.py makes the AnkiWeb page's What's new from them (npm run notes), dev/release.py the GitHub release's, and the add-on reads them for the About tab and for what an update announces. See release_notes.py for what an item can hold. One short sentence each.

new: "Animate the forest" is now On, Off, or Follow system, which keeps the forest still when your system is set to reduce motion.
The add-on now works in Anki 2.1.45 and later.
New sceneries and features now announce themselves, and the About tab shows what's new.
improved: Choose your scenery right on the General tab, from moving previews of each one.
Live weather now comes from MET Norway, and your city can be typed in its own language, like 東京.
A tree's tooltip now says when a leech's crow leaves: once the card is mature again.
fixed: A deck's own forest now reacts to how you study, just like your main forest, and on Peaceful it no longer shows the signs of bad habits.
The settings look right again in Anki 2.1.50, and the forest shows again in the versions of Anki made for older computers.
Unticking "Show my forest on my phone" now stays unticked after a sync from your phone.
A start date now begins the forest afresh: days before it no longer bring ancient-tree news, animals or Nature's marks.
The start date now follows Anki's day, which begins at its rollover hour.

new: Your forest on your phone, in AnkiDroid (turn it on in the General tab).
The forest notices how you study: good days and bad habits leave their marks.
Nature, a new setting on the General tab: choose how much the forest holds you to account for days away, from Peaceful to Wild to Merciless.
New animals to look forward to, years into your forest.
A new History tab: see how many trees each deck grows, leave decks out of the forest, or start it from a date.
A new scenery every month, and Memory Forest Plus on Patreon, where it arrives first.
Choose where the forest shows: on the main screen, on deck screens, or both (Fine-tuning tab).
improved: A tidier General tab, and a new scenery picker that shows each scenery as a picture.
Trees now stand on their own for up to two years before joining the deep forest at the back.
Rivers now wind through the middle of the forest.
The forest uses about 25% less memory, and opening the settings no longer leaks memory.
The add-on is packed about 27% smaller.
fixed: A pond now appears after one week away instead of two.
The forest no longer looks wrong after an update.
Aurora night's mountains no longer vanish behind a very big forest.
Ponds stay on the ground and no longer overlap.
The settings cog no longer grows a border on hover.
